title: NIS America Announces The Eminence in Shadow: Phantom Echoes Game
content: NIS America announced during Sony 's State of Play livestream on Thursday The Eminence in Shadow : Phantom Echoes , a new 3D action roguelite game based on Daisuke Aizawa 's The Eminence in Shadow ( Kage no Jitsuryokusha ni Naritakute! ) light novel series.
author: ANN

title: Fate/Extra Record Game's Trailer Reveals January 28 Release
content: Aniplex unveiled during Sony 's State of Play livestream on Thursday a trailer for Type-Moon studio BB's Fate/Extra Record game, the remake of Marvelous Entertainment 's Fate/Extra PlayStation Portable game.
author: ANN

title: Gundam: Rogue Orbit Game's Trailer Reveals March 2027 Release
content: Bandai Namco Entertainment began streaming a trailer on Thursday for Gundam Rogue Orbit , a new game in the Gundam franchise , and it reveals that the game will launch for PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S and PC via Steam in March 2027. The video previews the story, characters, and gameplay.
author: ANN

title: Netflix Confirms English Dub Release Schedule for Major Fall 2026 Return
content: The fall of 2026 is nearing, meaning a lot of new anime are going to be rolling out soon, and Netflix , as the second major platform, will be featuring many exclusives of its own as well.
author: ComicBook

title: Shimofuri Myojo's Seiya to Guest Star in New Ranma 1/2 Anime's Season 3
content: The staff for the third season in the new anime based on Rumiko Takahashi 's Ranma 1/2 manga announced on Friday that Seiya of comedy duo Shimofuri Myojo will guest star in the anime in a yet unannounced role and will serve as the promotional ambassador.
author: ANN

title: Attack on Titan Creator Returns for Official Blue Lock Crossover
content: Hajime Isayama is one of the most celebrated manga creators of all time, known for creating the award-winning series Attack on Titan . Ever since the manga reached its conclusion in April 2021, the creator has yet to return with a new series.
